description: hexa emits AG-UI 1.1 event streams for all working verbs

accepted.by: gary (in conversation, 2026-11-23: "accept the specs"; recorded by the implementing agent)

specs.description: JSON lines transport with --events flag
specs.given: hexa finish --events
specs.then: stdout is one JSON object per line, terminated by newline

specs.description: rejects invalid arguments before RUN_STARTED
specs.given: hexa finish --events --invalid-arg
specs.then: stderr contains the refusal, exit code is non-zero, no RUN_STARTED emitted

specs.description: run lifecycle for successful finish
specs.given: hexa finish --events
specs.when: the command runs in a repo with open work
specs.then: first event is RUN_STARTED, last is RUN_FINISHED with result

specs.description: run lifecycle for gate failure
specs.given: A repository whose gate script reports one failing test
specs.then: The last event is `RUN_ERROR` with code `gate_failed`; no `RUN_FINISHED` is sent and nothing is committed

specs.description: steps for gate verb
specs.given: A changed file and a gate script that reports one passing test
specs.then: `STEP_STARTED gate`, `STEP_FINISHED gate`, `STEP_STARTED land`, `STEP_FINISHED land` come in that order, all before `RUN_FINISHED`

specs.description: state snapshot at run start
specs.given: hexa finish --events
specs.then: first event after RUN_STARTED is STATE_SNAPSHOT with loop adr, gate, stage, checklist

specs.description: activity snapshot for open work
specs.given: hexa finish --events
specs.when: the command runs in a repo with open work
specs.then: one ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT with activityType hexa.open_work lists the items

specs.description: subagent lifecycle for harden reviewer
specs.given: A harden run that starts one reviewer
specs.then: `SUBAGENT_STARTED` carries `name` and `description`, it is followed by `SUBAGENT_FINISHED` or `SUBAGENT_ERROR`, and every event of that reviewer carries the same `subagentRunId`

specs.description: usage on terminal event
specs.given: A run whose spend ledger records input, output and cached tokens for two models of one provider
specs.then: `usage` on the terminal event holds one `TokenUsage` per model, and each model's cached tokens are part of its input total, never added on top

specs.description: emitter refuses invalid events
specs.given: any event before RUN_STARTED or after run close
specs.when: the emitter is asked to emit it
specs.then: The emitter refuses it and does not write it; the same holds for a step opened twice, a step closed that was never opened, and an optional field sent as `null`

specs.description: all events validate against vendored schema
specs.given: every event hexa builds
specs.then: validation passes

specs.description: A run never ends with a step still open
specs.given: A `do gate` run whose gate fails inside the `gate` step
specs.then: `STEP_FINISHED gate` is sent before `RUN_ERROR`; no `STEP_STARTED` is left without its `STEP_FINISHED`

specs.description: A change during the run is a delta, never a second snapshot
specs.given: `hexa loop task done 1 --events` in a loop with one open task
specs.then: Exactly one `STATE_SNAPSHOT` is sent, at the start; the change is a `STATE_DELTA` RFC 6902 patch against it

specs.description: The open-work list is activity, not transcript
specs.given: `hexa finish --events` in a repository with open work
specs.then: The open items appear only in the `hexa.open_work` `ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT`; no `TEXT_MESSAGE_*` event carries them

specs.description: The parent run's own events carry no subagentRunId
specs.given: A harden run with `--events` that starts one reviewer
specs.when: The run's own steps and terminal event are sent
specs.then: None of them carries a `subagentRunId`; only the reviewer's events do

specs.description: An absent count is never sent as zero
specs.given: A spend record for one model with input and output tokens and no cached or reasoning count
specs.then: That model's `TokenUsage` has no cached or reasoning field at all, rather than a field holding 0

specs.description: An early return closes the run itself
specs.given: A verb that returns an error while its first step is open
specs.then: The emitter sends `STEP_FINISHED` for the open step and then `RUN_ERROR`, though the verb wrote neither

specs.description: No verb writes event JSON itself
specs.given: The source of every verb that supports `--events`
specs.when: It is searched for code that builds or prints event JSON outside the emitter
specs.then: None is found: every event goes through the one emitter type

specs.description: hexa's events validate against the vendored schema
specs.given: The vendored `schema.json`, with its source and licence in PROVENANCE.md, and the events of `hexa finish --events`
specs.when: Each event is validated with the `jsonschema` crate
specs.then: Every event validates

specs.description: The oracle rejects a malformed event
specs.given: A `RUN_STARTED` event with `threadId` left out
specs.when: It is validated against the vendored schema
specs.then: Validation fails, so a test built on the schema catches an event hexa gets wrong
